decision: Shelve advancement of this candidate standalone claim at source gate; preserve conditional useful question and pending evidence.
finding: No candidate EMC spatial-protein result established. This is a source/assay/value review, not a new biology finding.
validity: EMC donor identities, complete conditions, ordinary public matrix access and candidate tumor compartment annotation not authenticated. The advertised four immune markers do not establish all-T-cell lineage/function or independently label malignant EMC cells.
value: A genuine EMC compartment-dependent CD8-positive cell pattern could add information beyond global paucity or macrophage prevalence only if area and total density controls distinguish exclusion, matched sarcoma conditions provide a meaningful contrast and source primary has not already reported it. Existing broad pan-cancer compositional/spatial findings and linked clinical immunoprofiling make simple density repetition or method demonstration unworthy.
strongest_alternatives: Global CD8 rarity, area/ROI selection and missing tumor boundary produce apparent exclusion
Clinical selected best block/3–6ROIs is not random whole-tumor tissue coverage; formalin/panel/segmentation/batch/source differences may dominate
No validated EMC malignant cell mask; pan-cancer or epithelial segmentation cannot be transferred by name
Repeated cores/ROIs or overlapping clinical cohorts inflate independence
Grade/site/treatment/purity/ECM and sparse EMC versus broad carcinoma controls confound subtype specificity
no_conclusions: No biological absence, immune therapy efficacy, exhaustion/Treg/M2 function, secretion/RNA/dependency, causation or prognosis
No universal source exhaustion or statement no authentic EMC occurs in the cohort
No source suitability exclusion from dataset size or current time; no marker threshold tuned toward values
bounded_next_decision: Do not stage numerical data, draft manuscript or promote now. Reopen only upon actual ordinary source primary/roster/access plus EMC donor-condition mapping, meaningful donor count, validated tumor/stroma masks/areas, matched sarcoma controls and source-specific prior-art gate. Then freeze one discriminating density-versus-localization contrast before values, evaluate every eligible EMC condition and complete relevant prior-source coverage/independent review.
terminal_scope: Quiet file/API metadata and primary-method text only; no UI/image/headless use, no count/case outcome numeric values or images inspected.
